open_questions: Price conflict: the Rates page says $1,550 / $2,250 / $2,550 / $2,750, but the comparison page lists $1,350 / $2,050 / $2,350 / $2,500 (Sun $2,350) 'as of July 2026'. A call should settle which is current.
Parking count differs by page: FAQ 'at least 40', parking flyer 31 + 16 = 47 lot spaces, comparison page '56 private spaces'.
Event coordinator filter: the site offers a manager who lets you in, reviews day-of details and is then on call. Team should decide whether that counts as an 'event coordinator' (marked false here).
Outdoors filter: the only outdoor event space is the courtyard, which is a paid add-on. Kept true because the venue has an outdoor event space; the team may prefer false under the paid-add-on rule.
Outside catering: the site lists preferred caterers and says couples have 'flexibility with the vendors you use' but never states a catering policy outright.
